additional_generations.prompt:
Adapt the supplied ORIGINAL restored TIDEKEEPER game map into a PORTRAIT 9:16 mobile map background. This is a framing/outpainting correction for the same asset, not a new location. Preserve its exact clean casual mobile-game rendering, daylight, color scheme, camera angle, building design and geometry, coral curved roof, one chimney, central teal door, BOTH open front windows, unchanged closed side windows, lit door lamp, lamp emblem, repaired deck, crates and shoreline.
CRITICAL: show the ENTIRE workshop roof, chimney, left and right front windows together inside the central upper-middle 60% of the portrait image. Keep those features away from left/right crop edges. Show water at the left. Expand world space above with the existing stone lane, low hedges and compact trees, and below with a broad quiet dock area and teal water. Reframe/zoom out only enough to fit ALL the important building and platform parts. Same near-isometric angle, no horizon or sky, no new buildings or landmarks.
The lower 22% must be quiet open dock/water, left blank for a separate dialogue interface. No text, no characters, no UI or controls generated into the picture. Portrait 9:16 image, not the original landscape canvas.
additional_generations.export: whole-canvas resize and transparent padding; no alpha removal

additional_generations.prompt:
Edit only the THREE restoration state details in this portrait TIDEKEEPER map. Preserve the exact portrait framing, building, roof, chimney, emblem, shore, dock, greenery, props, camera, colors and rendering.

Do not change the right-side wall windows or any other part of the scene. No new objects, no characters, text, UI or time-of-day change. Same portrait 9:16 image. This is the paired before-state of this exact portrait composition.
additional_generations.export: whole-canvas resize and transparent padding; no alpha removal
